```{r}
required <- c("readr", "dplyr", "DT", "knitr")
missing <- required[!vapply(required, requireNamespace, logical(1), quietly = TRUE)]
if (length(missing)) {
  stop("Missing report package(s): ", paste(missing, collapse = ", "))
}

root <- normalizePath(
  file.path("..", "..", "02_analysis", "output", "data_description"),
  mustWork = TRUE
)
read_table <- function(name) {
  path <- file.path(root, "tables", name)
  if (!file.exists(path)) stop("Required descriptive table missing: ", path)
  readr::read_csv(path, show_col_types = FALSE)
}
show_table <- function(data, caption) {
  DT::datatable(
    data, caption = caption, rownames = FALSE, filter = "top",
    options = list(pageLength = 10, scrollX = TRUE)
  )
}
show_figure <- function(name) {
  path <- file.path(root, "figures", name)
  if (!file.exists(path)) stop("Required descriptive figure missing: ", path)
  knitr::include_graphics(path)
}

overview <- read_table("dataset_overview.csv")
groups <- read_table("group_distributions.csv")
numeric_summaries <- read_table("numeric_summaries.csv")
missing_values <- read_table("missing_values.csv")
```

# Overview

The processed gender and growth dataset contains
`r overview$samples[overview$dataset == "Gender and growth dataset"]` participants.
The microbiome dataset contains
`r overview$samples[overview$dataset == "Microbiome TSE dataset"]` samples.
All microbiome sample identifiers were found in the gender and growth dataset.
Gender was matched to the microbiome metadata by sample identifier for this
description; the saved TSE object was not modified.

```{r}
show_table(overview, "Overview of the processed analysis datasets")
```

```{r}
#| fig-cap: "Gender distribution in the full and microbiome datasets."
show_figure("gender_distribution.png")
```

# Gender and growth dataset

## Group distributions

```{r}
show_table(
  dplyr::filter(groups, dataset == "Gender and growth dataset"),
  "Group distributions: gender and growth dataset"
)
```

## Numeric summaries

```{r}
show_table(
  dplyr::filter(numeric_summaries, dataset == "Gender and growth dataset"),
  "Numeric summaries: gender and growth dataset"
)
```

## Growth distributions

```{r}
#| fig-cap: "Growth-variable distributions in the gender and growth dataset."
show_figure("growth_distributions_gender_dataset.png")
```

## Growth correlations

```{r}

show_table(

)
```
